output.headline: TPG pairs a same-sub-sector precedent and 8 adjacent provider deals with upper-range pricing, but ranks 8th of 10 on the priority list.
output.differentiator: Pays a median 15.7x, ahead of Nordic Capital, Advent International, GTCR and all three strategics, and brings $303.0 billion of assets under management for firepower [T:record, P:1].

acquirer_overview.title: A large, closing-oriented sponsor with a mostly smaller-deal record
points: Financial sponsor with $303.0 billion in assets under management as of December 31, 2025; home sub-sector is Health Insurance [P:1, B:buyer].
18 deals from 2016 to 2023, of which 15 closed (83%); 4 deals since 2022 [T:record, K:closed_share, K:recent].
17 of 18 were control deals, and 9 of 18 were in provider services. Median deal is $88M; the biggest is $1,388M [K:control_share, A:angles, T:record].

strategic_fit_thesis.title: A credible but not compelling fit; the sub-sector precedent is a minority stake
points: Its record of buying from this kind of seller is a modest factor in its likelihood. Deal count and sector relevance are slight positives [S:own_fit_s, S:activity, S:sector_rel].
Bought Quality Medical Group ($187M, 2022) in the target's own sub-sector, but as a minority investment [D:MA-2022-0350].
Geography is a slight factor against: only 1 Midwest deal, and it has no open platform. 8 of 18 deals sit in the $100M-$400M size band [S:geo_fit, T:record, A:angles, K:size_band].

precedent_activity.title: Relevant precedents at $118M-$203M, at 8.8x to 12.2x
points: Granite Dental Network: $203M Platform Investment, 2021, at 12.2x EBITDA [D:MA-2021-0439].
Liberty Addiction Treatment: $118M Leveraged Buyout, 2021, at 8.8x EBITDA [D:MA-2021-0369].
Quality Medical Group: $187M minority investment, 2022, at 11.2x EBITDA. All three closed [D:MA-2022-0350].

valuation_context.title: Target merits upper-quartile pricing; TPG's history and capacity can reach it
points: 70 comparable deals: 25th percentile 10.7x, median 12.8x, 75th percentile 15.3x EBITDA [V:comps].
The 16.8% margin is above the comps' 12.9% median and above 87% of comps, which supports the 75th percentile [V:comps].
TPG's median paid is 15.7x, above the 75th percentile of 15.3x [T:record, V:comps].
At 5.0x leverage the equity cheque is $128M; IRR at the ask is 18.7% against a 20% target [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Size stretch
risk_flags.concern: Median deal of $88M is under half the $200M EV [C:conviction].
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 of 18 deals sit in the $100M-$400M band; the biggest is $1,388M [K:size_band, T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Capable of the cheque, but the typical TPG deal is smaller than this target [T:record].

risk_flags.title: Return at the asking price
risk_flags.concern: IRR at the ask of 18.7% is below the 20% target [V:lbo].
risk_flags.mitigant: A platform exit at 15.0x lifts the maximum price to $216M [V:lbo].
risk_flags.reality: At the same exit, the maximum is $193M; a bid at $200M needs the platform exit [V:lbo].

risk_flags.title: Thin Midwest and sub-sector presence
risk_flags.concern: Only 1 Midwest deal and 1 in the target's own sub-sector; no open platform [T:record, A:angles].
risk_flags.mitigant: 8 adjacent provider deals show it can underwrite provider businesses [T:record].
risk_flags.reality: Ranks 8th of 10 on the priority list, behind Welsh Carson and GTCR, which have 6 Midwest deals each [R:rank].

conviction.rationale: Low: 1 own-sub-sector deal and 8 adjacent deals support the case, but there is no open platform and the $88M median deal is under half the $200M EV. Likelihood is 3.7% [C:conviction, R:rank].
